summary: Maxeon Solar Technologies filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq delisting notice on April 24, 2026, after the High Court of Singapore placed it under interim judicial management on April 9, 2026. Trading suspension is set for May 1, 2026, unless the company appeals to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel. The company is evaluating whether to appeal. No financial terms, premium, or advisor are disclosed. This is a forced delisting due to insolvency proceedings rather than a voluntary deregistration. The key risk-arb angle is whether the company can successfully appeal or will cease trading, with potential OTC trading thereafter.
